SELECT KSKM.APKIHONCD , KSKM.SHOPCD , KSKM.SHOPNM , KSKM.KSIKKNCD , KSKM.KSIKKNNM , KSKM.KSHNSYSTMYMD , KSKM.KSHNSYSTMJIKAN , KSKM.IRAISMCNT , KSKM.IRAISMKIN , CM.ITEMNM AS JOTAINM , KSKM.ACIKEIYUKSIKBN FROM ( SELECT KSKM.APKIHONCD , KSKM.SHOPCD , SHPM.SHOPNM , KSKM.KSIKKNCD , KSKM.KSIKKNNM , KKRT.KSHNSYSTMYMD , KKRT.KSHNSYSTMJIKAN , KKRT.IRAISMCNT , KKRT.IRAISMKIN , CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(NVL(KKRT.JOTAI, '0')) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN KKRT.JOTAI ELSE '5' END AS JOTAI , KSKM.ACIKEIYUKSIKBN FROM S02M025T KSKM INNER JOIN S02M046T SHPM ON ( SHPM.APKIHONCD = KSKM.APKIHONCD AND SHPM.SHOPCD = KSKM.SHOPCD AND SHPM.YUKOKBN = '1' ) LEFT JOIN S09T002T KKRT ON ( KKRT.APKIHONCD = KSKM.APKIHONCD AND KKRT.SHOPCD = KSKM.SHOPCD AND KKRT.KSIKKNCD = KSKM.KSIKKNCD AND KKRT.SHIMEDYDM = #{shimedydm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND KKRT.YUKOKBN = '1' ) WHERE KSKM.ACIKEIYUKSIKBN IN ('3', '4') AND KSKM.YUKOKBN = '1' AND KSKM.ACIKSIKKNCD <> ' ' AND ( 0 = 1 OR KKRT.JOTAI IS NULL OR KKRT.JOTAI = '1' OR KKRT.JOTAI = '3' OR KKRT.JOTAI = '4' ) ) KSKM LEFT JOIN S01M004T CM ON ( CM.CONDITIONID = 'CN176' AND CM.ITEMNO = KSKM.JOTAI AND CM.YUKOKBN = '1' ) ORDER BY KSKM.APKIHONCD , KSKM.SHOPCD , KSKM.KSIKKNCD

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT , SUM(CASE WHEN KKRT.JOTAI = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EXECUTE_COUNT FROM S02M025T KSKM LEFT JOIN S09T002T KKRT ON ( KKRT.APKIHONCD = KSKM.APKIHONCD AND KKRT.SHOPCD = KSKM.SHOPCD AND KKRT.KSIKKNCD = KSKM.KSIKKNCD AND KKRT.SHIMEDYDM = #{shimedydm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND KKRT.YUKOKBN = '1' ) WHERE KSKM.ACIKEIYUKSIKBN IN ('3', '4') AND KSKM.ACIKSIKKNCD <> ' ' AND KSKM.YUKOKBN = '1'

SELECT KSKM.APKIHONCD , KSKM.SHOPCD , MAX(GADW.KEKKATORIKOMIDD) AS KEKKATORIKOMIDD , MAX(GADW.GMOYUKOKGN) AS GMOYUKOKGN , SHPM.SHOPNM , MIN(KSKM.KSIKKNCD) AS KSIKKNCD , KSKM.CRDTSPID AS CRDTSPID , MIN(KSKM.ACIKEIYUKSIKBN) AS ACIKEIYUKSIKBN FROM S02M025T KSKM LEFT JOIN S09W005T GADW ON ( GADW.APKIHONCD = KSKM.APKIHONCD AND GADW.SHOPCD = KSKM.SHOPCD AND GADW.GMOSPID = KSKM.CRDTSPID AND GADW.SHIMEDYDM = #{unyodate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) LEFT JOIN S02M046T SHPM ON ( SHPM.APKIHONCD = KSKM.APKIHONCD AND SHPM.SHOPCD = KSKM.SHOPCD ) WHERE KSKM.ACIKEIYUKSIKBN IN ('3', '4') AND KSKM.YUKOKBN = '1' AND KSKM.ACIKSIKKNCD <> ' ' GROUP BY KSKM.APKIHONCD , KSKM.SHOPCD , SHPM.SHOPNM , KSKM.CRDTSPID ORDER BY KSKM.APKIHONCD , KSKM.SHOPCD , KSKM.CRDTSPID

SELECT SKSM.APKIHONCD , SKSM.SHOPCD , KSKM.CRDTSPID , KSKM.CRDTCMPNYNO , SKSM.CRDTCRDNO , SKSM.CRDTCRDYUKOKGN , SKSM.SKYSAKICD , SKSM.KSIKKNCD FROM S02M025T KSKM INNER JOIN S02M017T SKSM ON ( SKSM.APKIHONCD = KSKM.APKIHONCD AND SKSM.SHOPCD = KSKM.SHOPCD AND SKSM.KSIKKNCD = KSKM.KSIKKNCD AND SKSM.CRDTCRDYUKOKBN = '1' AND SKSM.YUKOKBN = '1' ) WHERE KSKM.APKIHONCD = #{apkihoncd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND KSKM.SHOPCD = #{shopcd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND KSKM.ACIKEIYUKSIKBN = '3' AND KSKM.YUKOKBN = '1' AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT TKSM.JOTAISTS FROM S02M013T TKSM WHERE TKSM.APKIHONCD = SKSM.APKIHONCD AND TKSM.SHOPCD = SKSM.SHOPCD AND TKSM.SKYSAKICD = SKSM.SKYSAKICD AND TKSM.JOTAISTS NOT IN ('02', '06', '10') ) OR ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TKSM.JOTAISTS FROM S02M013T TKSM WHERE TKSM.APKIHONCD = SKSM.APKIHONCD AND TKSM.SHOPCD = SKSM.SHOPCD AND TKSM.SKYSAKICD = SKSM.SKYSAKICD AND TKSM.YUKOKBN = '1' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM S07T001T SKZD WHERE SKZD.APKIHONCD = SKSM.APKIHONCD AND SKZD.SHOPCD = SKSM.SHOPCD AND SKZD.SKYSAKICD = SKSM.SKYSAKICD AND SKZD.SHIMEDYDM = #{shimedydmm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND SKZD.YUKOKBN = '1' HAVING SUM(SKZD.KURIKOSHIKIN) > 0 ) ) ) ORDER BY SKSM.APKIHONCD , SKSM.SHOPCD , SKSM.KSIKKNCD

SELECT KSKM.KSIKKNCD KSIKKNCD, KSKM.KSIKKNNM KSIKKNNM, KSKM.SHIMEDDN1 SHIMEDDN1, KSKM.FURIKAEDDN1 FURIKAEDDN1, KSKM.FURIKAEIRAIHOHO FURIKAEIRAIHOHO, CNDM1.ITEMNM FURIKAEIRAIHOHONM, KKRT.SHIMEDD SHIMEDD, KSKM.KSIHOHOKBN KSIHOHOKBN, KKRT.KSIHOHOKBN KSIHOHOKBN1, KKRT.FURIKAEDYDMDD FURIKAEDYDMDD, KKRT.JOTAI JOTAI, CONM1.ITEMNM JOTAINM FROM S02M025T KSKM LEFT JOIN S09T002T KKRT ON ( KSKM.APKIHONCD = KKRT.APKIHONCD AND KSKM.SHOPCD = KKRT.SHOPCD AND KSKM.KSIKKNCD = KKRT.KSIKKNCD AND KKRT.SHIMEDYDM = #{shimedydm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND KKRT.YUKOKBN = '1' ) LEFT OUTER JOIN S01M004T CONM1 ON ( KKRT.JOTAI = CONM1.SETTEIATAI AND CONM1.CONDITIONID = 'CN176' ) LEFT OUTER JOIN S01M004T CNDM1 ON ( CNDM1.CONDITIONID = 'CN182' AND CNDM1.SETTEIATAI = KSKM.FURIKAEIRAIHOHO ) WHERE KSKM.APKIHONCD = #{apkihoncd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND KSKM.SHOPCD = #{shopcd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND KSKM.YUKOKBN = '1' AND KSKM.ACIKEIYUKSIKBN != '5' ORDER BY KSKM.KSIKKNCD
